name: Telegram MCP
headline: Telegram MCP: Multi-Account AI Management
short_description: AI-powered Telegram multi-account management tool with 123+ MCP tools for automated messaging, scheduling, and bulk outreach across 177 countries.
author: you922

sections.overview:
Telegram MCP Complete is an AI-driven management solution that integrates 123+ tools for controlling Telegram accounts through Claude Code and Cursor. It enables two-factor login via QR code or phone number verification across 177 countries, with a Web Dashboard for visual account management without coding. The skill automates batch messaging, scheduled tasks, message templates with variable substitution, and AI-powered message refinement to optimize tone and content. Built on Python with Telethon, FastAPI, and Vue.js, it supports message operations (send, receive, forward, edit, delete), group and channel management, contact handling, and media file management—making it essential for marketing professionals, growth teams, and bulk outreach campaigns requiring reliable automation and compliance monitoring.
Batch marketing campaigns to multiple Telegram accounts simultaneously
Automated scheduled messaging with customizable intervals and time zones
Multi-account monitoring and health status tracking via Web Dashboard
AI-enhanced message composition for professional tone and engagement optimization
